verdict.rationale: The evidence covers Gusto's Embedded Payroll API (single-company/employee operations, pagination, idempotency) but nowhere documents a bulk/batch operation capability (e.g., bulk employee updates, batch payroll processing across many items in one call). Pagination and idempotency are unrelated to bulk operations. missing for 10: no bulk/batch API endpoints, no batch job or multi-record operation documentation, no evidence of processing many items in a single request.
